_note: Per-topic PubMed search strings for the weekly pull (scripts/weekly_pubmed_pull.py). Deep extract will write these; Vibe reviews them before they are treated as final. Until then, queries with status placeholder-from-topics.json are copied from data/topics.json (the Daily ingest script already uses those pubmed_query values). dermatology and canine_atopic_dermatitis were not in topics.json; their queries are placeholders. Topics with no pubmed_query are skipped by the pull. Hits are written only to data/v5/ingest_queue.json for deep extract screening — they are not shown to readers until screened, written up, and listed in data/v5/weekly_new_approved.json.
